en: Prof. Juniper
Hi there, {player}! It's lovely to be able to talk to you in person at last. I'm Professor Juniper!
You took the Pokédex and came all the way out here with your partners. Let me see how you are getting on.
Marvellous! You've met so many Pokémon already. Thank you for your hard work. This is a token of my gratitude.
A Master Ball is the most powerful Poké Ball there is. It catches any Pokémon without fail.
Journeys are about meeting Pokémon, so never let one slip by. Keep the Master Ball for the one you really can't let go.
It still amazes me how much the Pokémon of this region have changed in two years. My research will never end. That's what makes it fun!
Professor Juniperrrrr!
Prof. Juniper
Why, if it isn't Skyla!
{player}, this is Skyla. She's Mistralton City's Gym Leader.
Skyla
Why are you so surprised, Professor? You asked for a lift in my plane to cross Twist Mountain, since you can't reach Opelucid City on foot!
Prof. Juniper
Ha ha, you're quite right! But I have a quick favour to ask first. I'd like to have a look at the Celestial Tower. Would you mind waiting until I'm through?
Skyla
Honestly! Okay, but don't take all day!
Prof. Juniper
See you, {player}! Be sure to get along with all kinds of Pokémon!
Skyla
Honestly! I can never tell whether she's laid back or just doesn't listen to anything outside her own head.
So you're {player}? I'm Skyla, Mistralton's Gym Leader, and a pilot besides. Nice to meet you!
What's next? Will you come to my Gym and challenge me? Or will you follow the professor to the Celestial Tower and train a little?
As long as I get to fly her over Twist Mountain in the end, I don't mind which!
Skyla
Are you coming to my Gym? Or to the Celestial Tower? Either is fine by me!
Prof. Juniper
Isn't it a marvellous place for research? So much wind! So much sky!
Youngster
Oh! You found our treasure!
Girl
Found it!
Youngster
Just kidding! Our Ducklett already knows Aerial Ace, so we'll give you this TM instead!
Aerial Ace never misses! We hope it helps you win!
Girl
See you! Bye-bye!
